Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that the director of “The Last Horror Movie (2003)” was David Winters based on misleading search snippets, confusing it with “The Last Horror Film (1982)” (which David Winters directed). They failed to verify the director’s identity with reliable sources before proceeding, leading to using David Winters’ birthplace (London) instead of the correct director Julian Richards’ birthplace (Newport).
